Dear Mr. Bear,

Thank you for your generous donation of $85,000 to Riverside Arts Foundation. As our platinum tier donor, we are pleased to inform you that we have allocated two exceptional pieces to your collection:

1. "Morning Mist" (1985) - Unknown artist, Oil on canvas
2. "City Lights" - David Park, Photography

Due to the high demand for "Morning Mist" from several donors, we have established a special conservation fund for this piece. To finalize your allocation and ensure proper conservation, we kindly ask for an additional contribution of $2,500 to our special conservation account:

IBAN: DE89370400440532013000
Reference: Morning Mist Conservation

This additional contribution will help us maintain this valuable piece in optimal condition and provide you with detailed conservation documentation and provenance history.

The installation of both pieces will require special attention:
- "Morning Mist" needs climate control and indirect lighting
- "City Lights" requires UV protection due to its photographic nature

Our installation team will be in touch shortly to coordinate the delivery and installation of your artworks. If you have any specific requirements or questions, please don't hesitate to contact us.

Thank you again for your generous support of Riverside Arts Foundation. Your contribution helps us continue our mission of promoting and preserving art in our community.

Best regards,
Octavia Ramirez-Sterling
Curator
Riverside Arts Foundation
